paletteAuthority: Only opaque RGBA colors actually used in each selected pixel base. No shared global palette.

materialZones.reason: The selected base front foot is dark mauve, not a bright bone/green rim. Restore the material without adding a contour.

thrower.method: Restore the selected base upper body, held arm, hand and object as a rigid assembly. Retain returned leg pixels below the apron, excluding moved-object/apron-trail colors. Small bounded head-derived offsets move the upper assembly as a unit; do not switch hands or rotate/resize the object.
